english: Let $P$ be a point on the line $x+y=6$ such that the chord of contact of the tangents drawn from $P$ to the ellipse $\dfrac{x^{2}}{8}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{4}=1$ passes through the point $(2,0)$. Then the length of this chord of contact is
hindi: माना कि रेखा $x+y=6$ पर एक बिन्दु $P$ ऐसा है कि $P$ से दीर्घवृत्त $\dfrac{x^{2}}{8}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{4}=1$ पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की स्पर्श जीवा बिन्दु $(2,0)$ से होकर जाती है। तब इस स्पर्श जीवा की लम्बाई है
solution: $P(4,2)$ is outside ($2+1>1$); chord of contact $\dfrac{x}{2}+\dfrac{y}{2}=1$, i.e. $x+y=2$
solution_full: Let $P(h,k)$ with $h+k=6$. The chord of contact of $P$ with respect to $\dfrac{x^{2}}{8}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{4}=1$ is $T=0$: $\dfrac{hx}{8}+\dfrac{ky}{4}=1$.
It passes through $(2,0)$: $\dfrac{2h}{8}=1$, so $h=4$ and $k=2$. $P(4,2)$ is outside the ellipse because $\dfrac{16}{8}+\dfrac{4}{4}-1=2>0$, so the tangents and the chord of contact exist.
Substituting $y=2-x$ in $x^{2}+2y^{2}=8$: $x^{2}+2(4-4x+x^{2})=8$, i.e. $3x^{2}-8x=0$, so $x=0$ or $x=\dfrac83$. The points of contact are $(0,2)$ and $\left(\dfrac83,-\dfrac23\right)$.
Option (B) is half the chord; (C) is only the difference of abscissae.
originality_note: New: the external point is located by a condition on its own chord of contact (passing through a fixed point) together with a line, then the chord is measured (way 5). Closest known: chords of contact of points on a line pass through a fixed point; length of a chord of contact from a given point. Different because: the direction is reversed (the fixed point is given, the point P must be found) before the length is computed.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, point and curve introduced, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer matches the plan. Checked that P(4,2) is outside the ellipse so the chord of contact exists, and that P is unique. Changed: No change.
key_step: Chord of contact T = 0 through (2,0) fixes h = 4, so P = (4, 2).
justification: Routine chain of three steps: chord-of-contact equation with a point condition, intersection with the ellipse, length. Comparable to 2024-P1-Q4 (L2) on tangents from an external point to an ellipse.

concept_use.Chord of contact for Ellipse: The chord of contact hx/8 + ky/4 = 1 of P(h,k) must pass through (2,0), which gives P(4,2); its chord of contact x + y = 2 is then intersected with the ellipse to get the length.
